releaseNotes: Preserves the V16 Firebase login/account flow, player, dialogue content, Learning/Practice modes and learner progress.
Adds Safe Merge for genuine duplicate vocabulary and phrases.
Safe Merge lets the owner choose which stable record to keep, combines allocations and useful alternatives, and retains the removed ID as a compatibility alias.
Migrates vocabulary status, resume position, spaced recall and dialogue-vocabulary progress to the surviving ID; phrase merges also combine phrase practice history.
Adds Archive for existing content and restricts permanent deletion to unused unpublished owner drafts with no progress or merge dependencies.
Adds searchable merge-candidate selection and warns that synonyms/different senses should remain separate.
Renames the reviewed save action to Save & Apply and explains the three-stage flow: Save Draft, Save & Apply, then Publish to GitHub.
Keeps the existing owner-content-v16.json GitHub path for backward compatibility, while publishing schema 1.1 with merge aliases.
Omits an empty owner-content-v16.json from the ZIP so an existing published owner-content file cannot be accidentally overwritten during a V17 upload.
